checkpoint.inspection_method: safetensors header only; names, shapes, and dtypes; no tensor values read

mapping_policy.weights_orientation: safetensors linear matrices are [out_features,in_features]; use torch.nn.functional.linear convention
mapping_policy.bf16_to_fp32: Convert each loaded BF16 tensor to FP32. This is an exact widening of the already-quantized stored values, not recovery of original pre-BF16 values.
mapping_policy.load_gate: Do not load any tensor values until the Zeta attention semantics change is available and the existing 6144 MiB available-memory gate passes.
mapping_policy.mapping_status: No checkpoint tensor values were loaded or mapped in this investigation.

per_layer_tensor_patterns.transformation: Linear projection then reshape. Apply within-head split-half-to-interleaved coordinate permutation before Zeta RoPE if retaining Zeta's RoPE primitive.
Linear projection then reshape. Apply the same within-head coordinate permutation as Q before RoPE.
Linear projection then reshape. Do not apply RoPE or Q/K coordinate permutation to V.
Direct linear projection after concatenating the 15 query-head outputs.
Linear projection; apply SiLU before elementwise multiplication with up_proj output.
Linear projection; multiply elementwise with SiLU(gate_proj(x)).
Linear projection from the SwiGLU intermediate dimension.
RMSNorm affine scale; epsilon=1e-5 from config; no bias tensor.
RMSNorm affine scale before the MLP; epsilon=1e-5 from config; no bias tensor.

derived_tensor_handling.target: Use model.embed_tokens.weight as output projection weight

required_mapping_invariants: All 290 checkpoint names must be accounted for exactly once: 2 global tensors plus 9 tensors for each of 32 layers.
Reject missing, unexpected, duplicate, wrong-shape, or wrong-dtype entries before loading values into a model.
No projection biases are expected: attention_bias=false and mlp_bias=false.
The 3:1 query-to-KV head grouping is preserved; do not reshape the K/V weights as if there were 15 KV heads.
The proposed RoPE coordinate permutation is applied to Q and K in each head, never to V.
The output projection reuses the tied token embedding parameter rather than creating an untied lm_head.
